title: Redenv Plugin Registry
description: Schema for a Redenv plugin's registry.json file.

name.description: Unique plugin identifier (e.g. 'studio', 'redenv-health'). Used as the plugin's slug.

displayName.description: Human-readable plugin name shown in the UI. Falls back to 'name' if omitted.

description.description: Short description of the plugin (1-2 sentences).

version.description: Current semver version of the plugin.

category.description: Plugin category for filtering. Reserved categories like 'official' are managed by the system.

status.description: Release status of the plugin. Defaults to 'stable' if omitted.

installCommand.description: The command users run to install the plugin (e.g. 'bun add -g @redenv/studio').

repository.description: URL to the plugin's source code repository.

docs.description: URL or path to the plugin's documentation page.
